title: Photo: columned building at night lit in rainbow colours
summary: A night photograph of a white columned building (a corner and portico view) floodlit in rainbow colours, with dark trees in the foreground. There is no text on the slide.

pictures.description: Night photo of a white neoclassical building with tall columns and a balustrade, its facade lit in bands of rainbow colour: yellow, green and red-orange on the portico, blue and violet toward the right, silhouetted trees in the foreground. It appears to be a side or corner view of the White House in Washington, D.C.

uncertain: Building shown from a side/corner angle; identified as the White House from the style and the matching next slide, not from any caption.
